CREATE TABLE "member" (
  "id" uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USER',

)

CREATE TABLE "site" (
  "id" uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  "name" text NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE "article" (
  "id" uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,
  "site_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "author_id" uuid,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "reviewed" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE
)
CREATE TABLE "article_published" (LIKE "article", "published_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "editor" (
  "id" uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  "site_id" uuid NOT NULL,

)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "member__u4" ON "member" ("email")
ALTER TABLE "article" ADD CONSTRAINT "article__site_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("site_id") REFERENCES "site"("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE

ALTER TABLE "article" ADD CONSTRAINT "article__author_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("author_id") REFERENCES "member"("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "article__author_id_idx" ON "article" ("author_id")
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "article_published__author_id_idx" ON "article_published" ("author_id")
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "article_published__site_id_idx" ON "article_published" ("site_id")

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "article__unpublish_fn"() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $aip$ BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN IF NEW."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL THEN DELETE FROM "article_published" WHERE "id" = OLD."id"; END IF; ELSE DELETE FROM "article_published" WHERE "id" = OLD."id"; END IF; RETURN NULL; END $aip$;
CREATE TRIGGER "article__unpublish" AFTER DELETE OR UPDATE OF "deleted_at" ON "article" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "article__unpublish_fn"()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "article__touch_fn"() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $aip$ BEGIN NEW."updated_at" := now(); RETURN NEW; END $aip$;
CREATE TRIGGER "article__touch" BEFORE UPDATE ON "article" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "article__touch_fn"()
ALTER TABLE "editor" ADD CONSTRAINT "editor__site_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("site_id") REFERENCES "site"("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "editor__site_id_idx" ON "editor" ("site_id")
ALTER TABLE "editor" ADD CONSTRAINT "editor__member_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("member_id") REFERENCES "member"("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "editor__member_id_idx" ON "editor" ("member_id")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "editor__u3" ON "editor" ("site_id", "member_id")

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "article__tenant_check"(rid uuid, deep boolean, depth int) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $aip$ DECLARE rec "article"%ROWTYPE; t uuid; r record; BEGIN IF depth > 16 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001', MESSAGE = 'aip:article__tenant'; END IF; SELECT * INTO rec FROM "article" WHERE "id" = rid; IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF; t := rec."site_id"; END $aip$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "article__tenant_fn"() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $aip$ BEGIN PERFORM "article__tenant_check"(NEW."id", TG_OP = 'UPDATE', 0); RETURN NULL; END $aip$;
CREATE TRIGGER "article__tenant" AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF "site_id" ON "article" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "article__tenant_fn"()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "_aip_tenant_pin"(t uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $aip$ DECLARE cur text := nullif(current_setting('aip.tenant', true), ''); BEGIN IF t IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF; IF cur IS NULL THEN PERFORM set_config('aip.tenant', t::text, true); ELSIF cur <> t::text THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001', MESSAGE = 'aip:_aip_tenant_pin'; END IF; END $aip$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "article__tenant_pin_fn"() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $aip$ BEGIN IF coalesce(current_setting('aip.tenant_cross', true), '') = 'on' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF; IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN PERFORM "_aip_tenant_pin"((OLD."site_id")); RETURN NULL; END IF; PERFORM "_aip_tenant_pin"((NEW."site_id")); IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD."site_id" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."site_id" THEN PERFORM "_aip_tenant_pin"((OLD."site_id")); END IF; RETURN NULL; END $aip$;
CREATE TRIGGER "article__tenant_pin" AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON "article" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "article__tenant_pin_fn"()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "site__tenant_pin_fn"() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $aip$ BEGIN IF coalesce(current_setting('aip.tenant_cross', true), '') = 'on' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF; IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN PERFORM "_aip_tenant_pin"((OLD."id")); RETURN NULL; END IF; PERFORM "_aip_tenant_pin"((NEW."id")); RETURN NULL; END $aip$;
CREATE TRIGGER "site__tenant_pin" AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON "site" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "site__tenant_pin_fn"()

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_outbox" (
  "id" bigserial PRIMARY KEY,

  "intent" text,
  "key" text,
  "payload" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "available_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

  "last_error" text,
  "done_at" timestamptz,

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_idempotency" (
  "intent" text NOT NULL,
  "actor" text NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_audit" (
  "id" bigserial PRIMARY KEY,

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_rate" (

)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_schedule_run" (

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_processed" (

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_notification" (
  "id" bigserial PRIMARY KEY,

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_mail" (

)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_grant" (
  "id" uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_aip_approval" (
  "id" uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
